body:
Addition from the maintainer, in chat on 2026-11-15. His words: "simplified layout designs is needed.."

Add this to the research:

11. Make simplified layout designs of the editor panel before the sub-issues are filed. Each design is a plain sketch (boxes and labels) that shows where these parts are: the script text, the sample selection, the G-code preview, the snippet library, the error line and the declared options. Make one design for the panel with the other panels open, and one for the panel alone. Attach the designs to this issue.

Done means, added: the layout designs are attached to this issue, and each UI sub-issue names the design that it implements.

## Research Answers

### 1. Smallest accepted script and blank template

- `Script::load` in `crates/post/src/post/js.rs` prepends `PRELUDE`, `ROTARY_CAP` (`crates/post/src/post/rotary_cap.rs`), and `EXPLAIN_JS` (`crates/post/src/post/explain.rs`). It then evaluates the `.cps` text in `boa_engine`.
- `Script::call` in `crates/post/src/post/js.rs` skips any hook function that the script omits.
- All manifest globals (`description`, `capabilities`, `serves`, `programUnits`, `coolantModes`, `afterModes`) are optional (`crates/post/src/post/dialect.rs`, `crates/post/src/post/units.rs`).
- An empty string `""` is the smallest script that `Script::load`, `SelectPost::validate` (`crates/app/src/commands/post.rs`), and `engine::run` (`crates/post/src/post/engine.rs`) accept.
- An empty script posts zero lines (`""`) with zero warnings on basic 3-axis milling streams.
- On streams that request special modes (non-flood coolant, stop or home after operation, live tooling, EDM, compensation, or plasma), `engine::run_program_with` emits the engine's counted gate warnings or refusals.

**Blank template:**

The blank template starts with a clean-room RS-274 / ISO 6983 provenance comment, minimal manifest globals, and empty hook stubs.

```javascript
// Clean-room post script template. Provenance: RS-274 / ISO 6983 public standard.
description = "Custom Mill (blank)";
vendor = "User";
legal = "Original work";
extension = "nc";
setCodePage = "utf-8";
capabilities = 1;
serves = ["mill"];
programUnits = "mm";

function onOpen() {}
function onSection() {}
function onRapid(x, y, z) {}
function onLinear(x, y, z, feed) {}
function onCircular(clockwise, cx, cy, cz, x, y, z, feed) {}
function onSectionEnd() {}
function onClose() {}
```

This template parses cleanly. It posts zero lines until the user adds code inside the hooks.

---

### 2. Sample programs for preview

- `crates/post/src/post/cnc.rs` parses both bare `.cl` toolpath dumps and full `.cnc` intermediate streams (`PARAM`, `TOOL`, `SECTION`, moves, cycles).
- Raw golden `.cl` files under `crates/app/tests/golden/` (such as `face_square_40x40.cl` and `drill_plate.cl`) omit `TOOL`, `PARAM SpindleSpeed`, `SECTION`, and canned-cycle feed words.
- `crates/app/tests/common/legacy_program.rs` (`as_program` and `with_cycle_feeds`) shows why: shipped dialects refuse bare streams with stopped spindle or zero cycle feed (`crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`).
- **Source 1 (built-in samples, no project needed):** Embed dressed `.cnc` sample streams made from committed goldens (`face_square_40x40.cl`, `contour_plate_with_hole.cl`, `pocket_zigzag_plate_with_island.cl`, `drill_plate.cl`, `drill_peck.cl`, `tap_plate.cl`, `arc_planes.cl`) using the `as_program` structure. Pair them with a default mill machine (`assets/machines/3axis-vmc.mch`). Also let users load a `.cl` or `.cnc` file from disk.
- **Source 2 (open project):** Offer `"Open project"` as a second source when operations exist and are fresh. Build the stream with `posting::stream_records` and `cnc::serialize` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`), using the document machine and `postOptions`. Disable `"Open project"` with `"Generate operations first"` when operations are missing or stale.

---

### 3. Preview execution trigger, time limit, and infinite-loop stop

- **Trigger:** Run the preview automatically after a short edit delay (250 ms after the last edit) and on a `Run` button click. Skip runs when script text, sample choice, and test options stay unchanged.
- **Stopping runaway scripts on desktop and web (`wasm32`):** `crates/ui/Cargo.toml` targets both native desktop and `wasm32`. Native OS threads do not provide a portable kill switch on `wasm32`.
- `boa_engine::RuntimeLimits` (`boa_engine-0.21.1/src/vm/runtime_limits.rs`) provides `set_loop_iteration_limit`, `set_recursion_limit`, and `set_stack_size_limit` directly on `boa_engine::Context`.
- Apply `RuntimeLimits` to `Script`'s `Context` before evaluating user `.cps` text (for example, 1,000,000 loop iterations plus default recursion and stack caps). Add a maximum output line cap (for example, 200,000 lines) in the engine buffer.
- This aborts `while (true) {}` loops, top-level infinite loops, and runaway output in milliseconds with a clean error message on both desktop and `wasm32`. It also hardens `SelectPost` and CLI runs.

---

### 4. Error display: line, message, warnings, and last good output

- Today, `Script::load` (`crates/post/src/post/js.rs`) joins `PRELUDE`, `ROTARY_CAP`, `EXPLAIN_JS`, and user `{cps}` into one `ctx.eval` string. That join shifts `boa_engine` line numbers (`"at line N, col M"`, noted in `crates/app/src/script/mod.rs`) down by the prelude line count.
- **Fix:** Evaluate `PRELUDE`, `ROTARY_CAP`, and `EXPLAIN_JS` in one `ctx.eval` call. Then evaluate the user `{cps}` text in a second `ctx.eval` call on the same `Context`. Syntax errors and runtime throws then report exact 1-based script line and column numbers.
- Show the error line number, column number, and message in the **Error line** strip. Include a `Jump to line` button and a red gutter marker on that script row.
- Show counted post `message()` warnings (`PostOutput::warnings`) and `PostOutput::swallowed` in the status strip so the author sees every gate blocker.
- Retain the **last good output** when the current script fails. Dim that stale preview with a banner (`"Showing last good output; script has errors"`). Mark every preview header with `"PREVIEW ONLY - use Post to write machine files"`.

---

### 5. First snippet library, storage location, and user snippets

Write all snippets cleanly from RS-274 / ISO 6983 standards and this repo's `PRELUDE` contract (`assets/posts/AGENTS.md`, `assets/posts/mazak.cps`, `assets/posts/grblhal.cps`):

- **Program start and end:** `onOpen` (`%`, O-word from `program`, `G20`/`G21`, `G90 G40 G49 G80`) and `onClose` (`M9`, `M5`, `G91 G28 Z0`, `M30`, `%`).
- **Tool change:** `onToolChange` and section tool call (`T.. M6`, `G43 H..`).
- **Spindle and coolant:** `onSpindleSpeed` checking `machine.spindleMax`, plus coolant lookup in `machine.coolants` (`M8`/`M7`/`M9`, `coolantModes = true`).
- **Linear and arc moves:** `onRapid` (`G0`), `onLinear` (`G1 F`), and `onCircular` (`G2`/`G3` with `I J`/`I K`/`J K` and modal `G17`/`G18`/`G19`), subtracting `OriginX/Y/Z`.
- **Canned cycles:** `onCycle`, `onCyclePoint`, `onCycleEnd` (`G81`/`G82`/`G83`/`G73`/`G84`, `G98`/`G99`, `G80`).
- **Work offset:** `WorkOffset` parameter (`G54`-`G59`) and origin helper.
- **Sequence numbers:** `N10`, `N20` line-prefix helper gated by a boolean option.
- **Declared option block:** Option definition block compatible with `#2049`.

**Storage and user additions:**

- Ship the 8 built-in categories as read-only Rust data so desktop and `wasm32` load them without disk dependency.
- Store user snippets as JSON files (`{ id, name, category, description, code }`) under `<user_posts>/snippets/*.json`. Write them atomically with temp-file-then-rename.
- Let users insert any snippet at the cursor, save selected editor text as a custom snippet, duplicate a built-in snippet to customize it, and delete user snippets.

---

### 6. Text editor widget and dependencies

- `crates/ui/Cargo.toml` uses `egui = "=0.36.2"` and includes no code-editor or syntax crate (`syntect`, `egui_code_editor`).
- **`egui::TextEdit` covers the core editor needs with zero new dependencies:**
  - `TextEdit::multiline(&mut text).code_editor()` (`egui-0.36.2/src/widgets/text_edit/builder.rs`) sets monospace text and `lock_focus(true)` so `Tab` inserts indentation.
  - `TextEditState` (`egui-0.36.2/src/widgets/text_edit/state.rs`) includes `TextEditUndoer` for text-buffer `Ctrl+Z` and `Ctrl+Y`.
  - `TextEdit::layouter(...)` applies custom `egui::text::LayoutJob` colors, matching the cached tokenizer pattern in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/gcode_highlight.rs`.
- **UI wrapper code needed around `TextEdit` (still zero new dependencies):**
  - Cache a JS tokenizer (`keywords`, `strings`, `numbers`, `comments`, `PRELUDE` hooks and globals) on text hash and theme mode.
  - Draw a synchronized line-number gutter beside `TextEdit` (`desired_width(f32::INFINITY)` inside a 2D `ScrollArea` keeps one source line per visual row) with an error marker.
  - Add an inline Find bar (`Ctrl+F`) that selects matches using `CCursorRange`.
  - Fix `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs` (`shortcuts`, lines 71-77): `Ctrl+Z` and `Ctrl+Y` currently run `actions::undo` and `actions::redo` even when `typing == true`. Gate document undo/redo behind `!typing` when a text field owns focus so `Ctrl+Z` undoes text inside the editor.
- **Recommendation:** Use `egui::TextEdit::code_editor` with a custom cached `LayoutJob` highlighter. Add no external crate.

---

### 7. Saved user scripts directory and UI discovery

- Mirror `crates/app/src/machine/store.rs` (`CAMCRAFT_MACHINES`) and `crates/app/src/fixture_library/store.rs` (`CAMCRAFT_FIXTURES`) with a user post store in `crates/app`:
  - Env override: `CAMCRAFT_POSTS` (absolute path).
  - Default folder: `<platform data dir>/camcraft/posts` (`%APPDATA%\camcraft\posts` on Windows, `~/Library/Application Support/camcraft/posts` on macOS, `$XDG_DATA_HOME/camcraft/posts` or `~/.local/share/camcraft/posts` on Linux). Never write to `assets/posts/`.
  - Atomic save: write a temp file beside the target and rename over it. Accept only plain filenames (`name.cps`) inside the user folder.
  - Let users save work-in-progress scripts to `<user_posts>` even when compilation fails, and warn in the status bar. Keep `SelectPost::validate` (`crates/app/src/commands/post.rs`) and `posting::post_setup` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`) refusing broken scripts before assignment or NC output.
- **UI discovery:**
  - Today, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` (`post_section`) renders the Setup post picker (`BUILTINS` dropdown plus `"Load post (.cps)"`) directly above `machine_section`. `Tab::Machines` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/machines_pane.rs`) browses `.mch` files and shows a read-only `Posts` row from `crates/app/src/machine/sheet.rs`.
  - Scan `<user_posts>/*.cps` cleanly (mirroring `machine::library::scan_dir`). List user scripts in a `"User posts"` group inside `post_section`'s dropdown (and in the editor's Open dialog). Queue `CommandKind::SelectPostFile(path)` (`PostRef::File`) on pick, and add an `"Edit post"` / `"New post"` button that opens the Post Editor panel.

---

### 8. Undo commands vs widget state, plus MCP tools

Following `AGENTS.md` ("Everything Is a Command") and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_file_editor.rs`:

- **Widget / editor view state only (no document `Command`, no `History`):**
  - Open, close, dock, or solo/expand the Post Editor panel (`LayoutRequest` in `crates/ui/src/state.rs`).
  - Edit script text, cursor position, scroll position, Find query, and text `Ctrl+Z`/`Ctrl+Y` (`TextEditUndoer`).
  - Select a preview sample stream or temporary preview test options.
  - Insert, add, or delete snippets, and Save / Save As `.cps` files to `<user_posts>`.
- **Undoable document commands (`History`):**
  - `"Use for document"` / `"Use for this setup"` on a saved `.cps`: run existing `SelectPost` or `SetSetupPost` (`PostRef::File(path)`).
  - `"Apply options to setup"`: run `#2049`'s undoable `SetPostOptions` or `SetSetupPostOptions` command. Temporary option tweaks in the editor do not modify CAD history.
- **MCP tools (`crates/app/src/mcp/`, `area:mcp`):**
  - Add `select_post`: run document-level `SelectPost` (referenced as missing in `crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs:238`).
  - Add `list_posts`: return built-in posts and discovered user `.cps` files with `serves`, `programUnits`, `extension`, and `#2049` option metadata.
  - Add `preview_post`: evaluate a `.cps` script string or file path with `RuntimeLimits` against a built-in sample or fresh open-project stream, and return G-code, warnings, swallowed count, errors, and options without writing an NC file.
  - Add `save_post_script`: save a `.cps` file inside the user posts folder with plain-name validation.
  - Update `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`.

---

### 9. Fit in the panel layout (#2002 and permanent Viewport)

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` defines `Tab { Viewport, Browser, Properties, Machines }`. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/mod.rs` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/layout.rs` keep `layout::closeable(&Tab::Viewport) == false`.
- `#2002` moves the tool catalog to its own dockable panel.
- Add `Tab::PostEditor` (`Panel::PostEditor` in `crates/ui/src/state.rs` and `ViewRow` in `layout/mod.rs`), closeable and floatable (`closeable == true`), closed by default. Open it from `View → Panels… → Post Editor` or from `Setup → Post → Post Editor`.
- **Closing everything else / Solo mode:** Because `Tab::Viewport` must stay non-closeable in `DockState`, add a **Solo / Expand** button inside the Post Editor bar. When active, `shell.rs` shows `Post Editor` across the whole central workspace (and can collapse/restore other panels) without breaking `Tab::Viewport` permanence or erasing the dock tree. Users can also close `Browser`, `Properties`, `Machines`, and `Tools` normally via their tab close buttons.

---

### 10. Relation to #2049 (Declared post options)

- `#2049` (`P4`, open) defines the `.cps` declared-option schema (`key`, `label`, `type`, `default`, `group`, `description`), reads declared options in `camcraft-post` without running a program, and renders a grouped option grid backed by `SetPostOptions`.
- The Post Editor reuses `#2049`'s option reader and grouped property-grid widget directly.
- Every preview pass parses the temporary script's declared options into the **Declared options** pane. Invalid declarations appear in the **Error line** banner.
- Editing test values in the editor updates preview `postOptions` live without adding undo history. Clicking `"Apply to setup"` queues `#2049`'s undoable command.

---

### 11. Simplified layout designs

#### Design A: Post Editor panel docked with other panels open

When `Browser`, `Viewport`, and `Properties` stay open, horizontal space for `Post Editor` is compact. Split the editor into two columns plus a compact tabbed bottom-right pane so every required control stays readable.

|            |                                        |  [User posts] [Post Editor]|
|            +----------------------------------------+----------------------------+
|            | Post Editor  [Expand / Solo] [x]                                    |
|            | +-----------------------------------------------------------------+ |
|            | | Toolbar: [Blank][Open][Save][SaveAs][Use Post]                  | |
|            | |          [Sample selection: 2D Contour (v)] [Run] [Auto] [Find] | |
|            | +-------------------------------+---------------------------------+ |
|            | | Script text                   | G-code preview (PREVIEW ONLY)   | |
|            | |  1 | // Provenance...         |   1 | %                         | |
|            | |  2 | description = "...";     |   2 | O0001                     | |

#### Design B: Post Editor panel alone (other panels closed / Solo mode)

When the user closes other panels or clicks `Expand / Solo`, `Post Editor` fills the full central workspace with three wide columns showing snippet library, script text, G-code preview, declared options, sample selection, and error line at once.

## Design Proposal (Smallest Useful First Slice First)

1. **Slice 1 (`camcraft-post` core):** Evaluate user `.cps` text separately from `PRELUDE` for exact 1-based line numbers, enforce `boa_engine::RuntimeLimits` plus output line bounds so runaway scripts stop cleanly on desktop and `wasm32`, and embed the Blank Template and dressed sample `.cnc` streams.
2. **Slice 2 (`camcraft-app` store & preview runner):** Add the user posts folder (`CAMCRAFT_POSTS` / `<data dir>/camcraft/posts`) with atomic `.cps` writes, folder scanning, and a read-only `preview_post` service that never writes NC files.
3. **Slice 3 (`camcraft-ui` first panel slice — Design A & Design B core):** Add `Tab::PostEditor` / `Panel::PostEditor` (`View → Panels…`, `Setup → Post`, and `"Expand / Solo"` focus mode), `TextEdit::code_editor` with cached JS syntax highlighting, 1:1 gutter, Find bar, focused `Ctrl+Z` fix, sample selection, debounced G-code preview with last-good retention, and the error line.
4. **Slice 4 (Snippet library — Design A drawer & Design B left sidebar):** Ship the 8 clean-room built-in snippet categories plus atomic user snippets in `<user_posts>/snippets/`.
5. **Slice 5 (Declared options & open project — Design A & B integration, after `#2049`):** Connect `#2049`'s declared-options parser and grouped property grid into **Declared options**, and add `"Open project"` to **Sample selection**.
6. **Slice 6 (MCP surface):** Add `list_posts`, `select_post`, `preview_post`, and `save_post_script` in `crates/app/src/mcp/` and update `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`.

---

## Proposed Sub-Issues

1. **Post engine: 1-based script errors, loop limits, blank template, and preview sample streams**
   - Separate user `.cps` evaluation from `PRELUDE` under `boa_engine::RuntimeLimits`, and add the Blank Template and dressed sample `.cnc` streams in `camcraft-post`.
   - Done means: Tests verify 1-based line numbers on syntax/runtime errors, an infinite loop stops via `RuntimeLimits`, the Blank Template posts zero lines with zero warnings, and all sample streams post through `fanuc.cps` and `mazak.cps`.
   - Proposed: `P4`, `effort:high` (safety floor: changes `camcraft-post`), `area:post`.

2. **User post store and read-only preview service in camcraft-app**
   - Add user `.cps` folder resolution (`CAMCRAFT_POSTS` or `<data dir>/camcraft/posts`), atomic `.cps` save/scan, and a read-only `preview_post` runner that never writes `.nc` files.
   - Done means: Tests pin `user_dir_for`, atomic save validation, and `preview_post` returning G-code, counted warnings, and 1-based errors without writing disk NC output.
   - Proposed: `P4`, `effort:high`, `area:post`.

3. **Post Editor dock panel: script text, sample selection, live G-code preview, error line, and user post picker (Design A and Design B)**
   - Implements Design A and Design B core (`Tab::PostEditor`, Solo/Expand toggle, cached JS syntax highlighting on `TextEdit::code_editor`, 1:1 gutter, Find bar, focused `Ctrl+Z` fix, sample selection, debounced G-code preview with last-good output, error line with Jump, Save/Save As/Use Post, and user `.cps` entries in Setup → Post).
   - Done means: Structural tests (`egui_kittest`) verify opening `PostEditor` from `View → Panels…`, Solo/Expand toggling, live preview updates, retaining last-good output with error line on failure, saving to temp `CAMCRAFT_POSTS`, and picking the saved post in Setup → Post.
   - Proposed: `P4`, `effort:high`, `area:ui`.

4. **Post Editor snippet library: clean-room built-in snippets and user snippets (Design A and Design B)**
   - Implements the Snippet library pane in Design A (tabbed drawer) and Design B (left sidebar) with 8 clean-room built-in snippet categories and user snippets in `<user_posts>/snippets/`.
   - Done means: Every built-in snippet compiles and posts expected RS-274 blocks in tests over sample streams, users can save/insert/delete custom snippets in temp `CAMCRAFT_POSTS`, and structural UI tests verify snippet insertion at cursor.
   - Proposed: `P4`, `effort:high` (safety floor: authors G-code output snippets), `area:post`, `area:ui`.

5. **Post Editor declared options tester and open-project sample stream (Design A and Design B, after #2049)**
   - Implements the Declared options pane and `"Open project"` choice in Sample selection for Design A and Design B using `#2049`'s schema parser, grouped grid, and `SetPostOptions` / `SetSetupPostOptions` commands.
   - Done means: Editing a declared option in the script updates Declared options live, changing a preview test value updates G-code preview without adding CAD undo entries, `"Apply to setup"` queues `#2049`'s command, and `"Open project"` previews fresh generated operations.
   - Proposed: `P4`, `effort:high`, `area:post`, `area:ui`.

6. **MCP: list_posts, select_post, preview_post, and save_post_script**
   - Add headless MCP tools in `crates/app/src/mcp/` for listing built-in/user posts, selecting the document post (`SelectPost`), running read-only post previews, and saving user `.cps` scripts, and update `camcraft-mcp` skill docs.
   - Done means: MCP tests verify `list_posts`, `select_post` (with undo), read-only `preview_post` (returning G-code, warnings, and errors without writing NC files), and `save_post_script` path checks.
   - Proposed: `P5`, `effort:medium`, `area:mcp`.

## Filed Sub-Issues

I filed the six sub-issues below for this research:

1. #2069 — Post engine: 1-based script errors, loop limits, blank template, and preview sample streams (`P4`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
2. #2070 — User post store and read-only preview service in camcraft-app (`P4`, `effort:high`, `area:post`; builds on #2069)
3. #2071 — Post Editor dock panel: script text, sample selection, live G-code preview, error line, and user post picker (Design A and Design B) (`P4`, `effort:high`, `area:ui`; builds on #2070)
4. #2072 — Post Editor snippet library: clean-room built-in snippets and user snippets (Design A and Design B) (`P4`, `effort:high`, `area:post`, `area:ui`; builds on #2070 and #2071)
5. #2073 — Post Editor declared options tester and open-project sample stream (Design A and Design B, after #2049) (`P4`, `effort:high`, `area:post`, `area:ui`; builds on #2049 and #2071)
6. #2074 — MCP: list_posts, select_post, preview_post, and save_post_script (`P5`, `effort:medium`, `area:mcp`; builds on #2070)

This umbrella issue stays open with `needs-research` for maintainer review.
Research complete: sub-issues #2069, #2070, #2071, #2072, #2073, #2074 (decisions in the comments above)
